tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nyams len bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i sa gzhi 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rje btsun bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon mnyam gzhag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can/ de'i mtha' skor rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ gu ru rat+na saṃ bha wa sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ d+dhu pe/ a lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da/ mahā sarba a mṛ ta bo dhi tsit+ta a ho mahā su kha āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/ maṇ+ḍal lan gsum la sogs pa ci mang 'bul/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dbul phongs bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dbang phyug snyan grags lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces sogs kyis yid la gang 'dod kyi gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/

de nas/ bla ma'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las 'dod dgu'i char bab pas/ bdag nyid kyi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ bla ma dam pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres shing*/ rang nyid kyang bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skur gyur pa'i phyag gi mchog sbyin las 'dod dgu'i char bab pas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshim par byas/ de thams cad bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur nas/ slar yang rang nyid la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub byin par gyur par bsams/ de ltar bsam pa thams cad kyang legs par brtag na rang gi sems nyid kho na'i rnam 'phrul yin/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa'i mtha' dang bral bar bsam nas/ 'dzin med kyi ngang du lus sems khong glod nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par 'jog rjes su/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang sogs brjod/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*// rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog / sogs bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa brjod/ 'di ni thun gcig gi nyams len gyi rim pa la/ tshul 'di lta bus thun bzhir bcad/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab nan du byas nas zhag bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa'i 'bad rtsol du nyams su blangs pas/ dngos sam/ nyams sam/ rmi lam ci rigs par rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i rtag gsal por 'byung zhing*/ zla ba mi thogs par grub mtha' snyog pa dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gsungs pas/ nyams len gyi rim pa la brtson par bya'o// rje btsun bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan la// brten nas nus pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs// sa skya'i rje btsun mchog gi thugs bcud 'di// bla ma'i dran gyur blo gsal rgya mtshos sbyar// de las byung ba'i rab dkar dge ba'i las// 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser zhun lta bu des// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mi dbang 'khor bcas kyi// chab srid yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas shog

/ces pa'i yi ge pa ni bla ma'i bka' 'bangs 'a zhwa'i ban+des bgyis pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
